smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_bertz_ct = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_ipc = (_: {

}) => any;

type get_hall_kier_alpha = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa1 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa2 = (_: {

}) => any;
